properties.NAME: Attakapas County
properties.CHANGE: Attakapas County created by Orleans Territory to "comprehend the [ecclesiastical] parish of St. Martin, commonly called the parish of Attakapas."
properties.CITATION: (Orleans Terr. Acts 1804, 1st Leg., 1st sess., ch. 25/p. 144-152; Calhoun, 72-80; Goins and Caldwell, 41)
